content: Yes, but I don't have enough time for it. I have so many other things to do every day.
It is the same with me. I can read Chinese now but I still find it difficult to speak Chinese and I don't always understand people when they speak Chinese to me.
We don't hear Chinese enough I think. Do you listen to the radio from China?
Yes, I listen to the news from China almost everyday. That helps me understand Chinese but not to speak it.
We'd better go to China for a holiday.
Right. That'll be the best way.
